items.Sentence: Wastewater is collected at four separate lift stations and then directed to the Facility which is an extended aeration package treatment plant. The treatment system consists of two above ground aeration units equipped with fine bubble diffusers, two air-blowers, and one secondary clarifier.

The Discharger filed a report of waste discharge and submitted an application for renewal of the Waste Discharge Requirements on April 13, 2009 to discharge up to 100,000 gallons per day (gpd) of secondary treated wastewater to on-site evaporation/percolation ponds.
Waste sludge from the clarifier is currently discharged to an unlined basin where it is dried and then hauled offsite for proper disposal.
